title: startup
description: The closed list of keys the startup file (proxy_config.yml, or the file AZIZAM_CONFIG_PATH names) may hold. A startup setting is one the gateway needs before it opens admin.db, or one that a running gateway cannot change (a listener, a storage root, a login boot rule, a secret). Every other setting lives in admin.db, as an owner override of a config section (registry/defaults/) or as a record of the service registry (docs/design/CONFIG_HOMES.md, rule 3). Startup refuses a key that is not listed here and says where the setting lives now (x-azizam-moved).

x-azizam-moved.backends: the service registry. Add and edit engines in the admin UI (Services), or import them with POST /admin/api/config/import.
x-azizam-moved.providers: the service registry. Add and edit remote providers in the admin UI (Services).
x-azizam-moved.routing: nothing. No code read this section; delete it.
x-azizam-moved.admin.user_defaults: access plans and the invitation default (Settings > Access plans). Nothing read this key from the file.
x-azizam-moved.model_compatibility.generated_aliases_fi: a release file, registry/openai_model_aliases.generated.yml. Its path is not a setting.

host.description: Address the gateway binds. Bind 127.0.0.1 unless a proxy or a trusted network needs more.

version.description: Version label that the MCP front door and the config export report. Default 1.

admin.description: Where the database is, how browser sessions are signed, and the sign-in provider of a first boot.

db_path.description: Path of admin.db, relative to the repository when not absolute.

session_signing_key.description: Browser-session signing key, at least 32 bytes. Prefer session_signing_key_env.

session_signing_key_env.description: Name of the environment variable that holds the browser-session signing key.

wordmark.description: Optional deployment mark, "name.tld". A generic install shows only the neutral product mark.

oidc.description: The sign-in provider the gateway uses until admin.db holds one (admin.db's oidc_provider_config wins once it does).

admin_emails.description: Addresses that may become the first owner while no owner exists.

secure.description: false only for a localhost HTTP first run. Set true before the gateway is reached over HTTPS.

auth.description: Login boot rules: who the gateway trusts to tell it a client address, and where first-run setup is allowed.

public_paths.description: Paths that need no key. Default: /health.

trusted_proxies.description: Proxies whose X-Forwarded-For the gateway honors, as addresses or networks.

setup_allowed_cidrs.description: Client networks that may claim the first owner account. Loopback is always allowed.

cloudflare_mode.description: Honor CF-Connecting-IP from verified Cloudflare edge addresses only.

allow_query_param_key.description: Accept ?api_key=<key> from clients with no auth header field.

mcp.description: The MCP front door: whether OAuth is on and how long its grants live.

request_body_limits.description: Largest request body for JSON routes and for media routes. The limit is built when the process starts.

images.description: Storage roots and the URL signing secret of the image routes.

cache_dir.description: Durable media storage for the Library and `response_format: url`.

signed_url_secret.description: HMAC secret for signed media URLs. Empty or unset: generated at first run and kept in <cache_dir>/.url_signing_secret, mode 0600.

payload_dir.description: Where queued image job payloads are kept. A storage root.

dir.description: Where custom voices are stored, relative to this file. A storage root.

workflows_dir.description: Directory of the audio workflow graph files. A storage root.
